# Patch server.js to register the route
if ! grep -q "palworld_settings_route" /opt/control-panel-backend/server.js; then
    # Insert the require and registration after the express app is created
    python3 - <<PYEOF
import re
with open("/opt/control-panel-backend/server.js") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Add require at the top after other requires
require_line = "const registerPalworldSettingsRoute = require(\"./palworld_settings_route\");\n"
if "registerPalworldSettingsRoute" not in content:
    # Insert after the last require line
    lines = content.split("\n")
    last_require_idx = -1
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.strip().startswith("const ") and "require(" in line:
            last_require_idx = i
    if last_require_idx >= 0:
        lines.insert(last_require_idx + 1, require_line.rstrip())
    else:
        lines.insert(0, require_line.rstrip())
    content = "\n".join(lines)

# Add registration after app is created
if "registerPalworldSettingsRoute(app)" not in content:
    content = content.replace(
        "const app = express();",
        "const app = express();\nregisterPalworldSettingsRoute(app);"
    )

with open("/opt/control-panel-backend/server.js", "w") as f:
    f.write(content)
PYEOF
fi

# Restart the service
systemctl restart control-panel.service
